title: The 5 Rudest Cities in South Florida

scenes.text: The five rudest cities in South Florida. And number one... isn't even close.
Number five, Weston. Nobody says hi, but the H.O.A. will fine you for half an inch of grass.
scenes.caption: Number five, Weston. Nobody says hi, but the HOA will fine you for half an inch of grass.

scenes.text: Number four, Boca. They'll cut you in line at Publix, then tell you to wait your turn.
Number three, Fort Lauderdale. Boat music at two in the morning, and on I ninety-five, brakes are optional.
scenes.caption: Number three, Fort Lauderdale. Boat music at 2AM, and on I-95, brakes are optional.

scenes.text: Number two, Miami Beach. A thirty-eight dollar drink, a bouncer who hates you, and your car is already getting towed.
scenes.caption: Number two, Miami Beach. A $38 drink, a bouncer who hates you, and your car is already getting towed.

scenes.text: And number one... Miami. Where using your turn signal is a sign of weakness.
